full_page.content:
1933, September 20
Owen J. B. and Martha Casey
Page 2.
"Without me you can do nothing" Jesus assures us. How then can anyone, believing in Jesus, hope to be temperate in anything without Jesus - how can we be gentle like Him and pure and patient? How be earnest for good: how successful on the battlefield of this short life? In other words, how gain Heaven & escape Hell without frequent Comunion? Dear Owen. Go to Jesus as often as you can -- why not every day? and plead with Him to teach us all "loving appreci- ation" of His invitation - His plea to each of us: "Come to me all ye that labor and are heav'y burdened. With such a standing plea we have no excuse for fail- ing to be saints. Plead too for the grace to love your wife and children for God's sake. . . Alas how little that grace is prayed for! No wonder the divorce plague
God bless you Owen. . . God bless you Martha. God bless the children and all.
Fr. S.
